translations.web: Other seed fell on the rock, and as soon as it grew, it withered away, because it had no moisture.
translations.bsb: Some fell on rocky ground, and when it came up, the seedlings withered because they had no moisture.
translations.kjv: And some fell upon a rock; and as soon as it was sprung up, it withered away, because it lacked moisture.
translations.asv: And other fell on the rock; and as soon as it grew, it withered away, because it had no moisture.
